'''Abominelle''' was a [[Venan]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], and the Royal [[Margravine]] of [[Vena]]. While touring Fornax Station on the eve of her wedding, she was interrupted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the plan concocted by the station's security officer, [[Smurdap]], to capture the smuggler. Her wedding was called off after she fell in love with Solo.

==Biography==
Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], on the eve of her wedding, Abominelle was touring the [[Fire Rings of Fornax]] on Fornax Station when she was interrupted by the smuggler Han Solo and his co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. During their interaction, Solo insulted Abominelle and walked off, leaving the Royal Margravine speechless.<ref name="FRR" />

Later that night, her [[Shimmersilk/Legends|Tyrian shimmersilk]] wedding dress was stolen by the station's security officer, [[Smurdap]], as part of his plot to blackmail Chewbacca and Solo into turning over their contraband. While Solo remained oblivious, he was alerted to the plan after his attention was drawn by Abominelle's screaming. He, again, walked away after insulting her for making a scene.<ref name="FRR" />

Her dress was returned after Smurdap was outwitted and under custody. The next time that she saw Solo, she told him that she had called off her wedding because she was in love with someone else, implying that she was attracted to him. He politely took her hand when she offered it, before telling her that Chewbacca wanted to know whether there was a reward for returning her dress. Infuriated, Abominelle began screaming again.<ref name="FRR" />

==Personality and traits==
As a member of Venan royalty, she appeared to be extremely spoiled. Abominelle was prone to screaming when she was inconvenienced, and tended to accost those who interfered with her plans.<ref name="FRR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Abominelle made her first and only appearance so far in the 2010 young reader novel ''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race]]'' by [[Ryder Windham]].
